description: Hand your result to the agent that gave you your task; it ends your turn. Call it when the task is done, or when you are blocked or have failed, saying why. Your parent may pass it on to the user, so use plain words and make each decision or question in it stand alone: what is decided, the facts and the options, never pointing to "above". Write it as your task and your instructions ask; its first line is what lists of agents show, so lead with the outcome.

text.description: The whole report, in the form your task or instructions ask for.

name: report
